name: Matsukawa Isuke
source:
"The manager of MANKAI Company. Although his appearance is shabby and he has a weak personality, his belief in MANKAI Company is genuine. He first reaches out to the Director (by sending a letter to her father) seeking help in restoring the company to its former glory."
